gate: AR OS 1.72 QEMU DSPI startup and first non-zero framebuffer

firmware.label: Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.72 extracted MAIN

dspi0.modeled_behavior: Each PUSHR write creates one zero-valued POPR FIFO entry and updates RXCTR/RFDF/completion flags.
dspi0.proof: Firmware crossed the prior SR.RXCTR polling loop and executed UI/runtime code in 0x400a, 0x400f, and 0x4016 ranges.

interrupt_correction.cause: UART8 RX level had been incorrectly wired directly to INTC1 source 26.
interrupt_correction.trace_evidence: The vector handler writes eDMA CINT=34 and masks/unmasks INTC1 source 26, identifying it as the eDMA channel 34 completion path.
interrupt_correction.correction: UART8 request is kept separate from the CPU INTC line pending an eDMA request model.

next_gate.name: UART8-to-eDMA channel 34 transfer path
next_gate.objective: Model UART8 RX DMA requests, TCD progress, CINT/INTC completion behavior, and observe whether the panel framebuffer advances beyond the first stable non-zero image.
